reasons.persona_fit: Directly speaks to small-business owners in Bareni's calm, practical voice, adhering strictly to the no-CTA rule and scope boundaries.
reasons.clarity: Unambiguous structure with an immediate central point, contrasting bounded workflows with vague wishes in plain language.
reasons.actionability: Provides a concrete, realistic three-line scoping framework and clear rules on when to keep a process manual.
reasons.factual_grounding: Makes no unsupported claims, avoids hype or invented results, and properly incorporates required human approval gates.
